response.text:
I can do that. Quick clarifying decision before I proceed (you said you already ok’d general action, so this is just about how to handle mismatches):

- Duplicate detection: I will match vendors by normalized name (trimmed, case-insensitive).
- When name matches but vendor ID differs: do you want me to
  1) Prefer the 2025 vendor ID (keep that ID and remove the duplicate row in 2024), or
  2) Prefer the 2024 vendor ID, or
  3) Keep the first occurrence encountered and remove the later duplicate, or
  4) Merge IDs into the kept row (e.g., store both IDs in a single field), or
  5) Mark duplicates (add a "DuplicateOf" column) instead of deleting rows?

I will preserve formulas and sheet structure (won't overwrite formulas) and update/save the workbook after dedupe. If you confirm which option to use (or say “use your default”), I’ll inspect the 2024 and 2025 sheets and perform the dedupe. Which do you prefer?
